rationale: Stay invested in the whole basket and trade only the range-bound stretches: when the trailing mean-reversion speed of the equal-weight index is above what a random walk produces, sell once the index is stretched above its rolling mean and buy back when it returns. Reading the regime from the index rather than from single names keeps idiosyncratic noise out of the signal.
evidence: index variance ratio below 1 at 20-40 bar horizons
trailing reversion speed above the random-walk level for a large share of training bars
